title: FleXray
summary: Foundation model for universal clinical X-ray anatomy segmentation (60 structures) across body regions, views, and acquisition settings. Designed for on-device / local inference.
cite: Victor Ion Butoi, Vivek Gopalakrishnan, John V. Guttag, Adrian V. Dalca, and Neel Dey (2026). FleXray: Universal Clinical X-ray Segmentation. arXiv:2609.26756
